feature: Customer Portal v2 -- PII Governance (/portal-v2/pii), WIRED TO REAL DATA. The page previously rendered the design fixture PII_GOVERNANCE (piiData.ts) -- a fictional per-document PII discovery scan with named SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams/Exchange sources, matched patterns, an access matrix and a drift feed. It now renders the calling customer's OWN real data from GET /api/portal/pii-governance (requireRole('CustomerUser'), scoped by (msp_id, tenants.tenantId) off the JWT). The real backing is the four aggregate Purview compliance monitor-checks (compliance:missing-labels / label-errors / weak-dlp-policies / dlp-incidents) already scored by copilot-readiness.ts -- org-level COUNTS + a matched-severity sentence, not per-document detail. There is no content-inspection PII discovery scan in the platform, so the fixture's sources/patterns/access/drift have no collected backing and are NOT shown; the 'Where this comes from' panel names every backing check's real status instead.

WHAT CHANGED AND WHY THE OLD ASSERTIONS ARE GONE. The previous version asserted the FIXTURE: 'At risk' status, the summed 'files hold personal data' headline, four fixture findings PII-01..PII-06, the RSK-014 per-finding risk button, the four named sources (SharePoint sites / Exchange attachments), the seven patterns (National insurance and SSN / Halden employee number format), the access rows (2 external accountants) and the drift feed. Every one of those was fixture data with no collected backing and is now false for any real tenant. They are replaced, not deleted quietly -- the fixture derivations they pinned still run over the fixture on purpose in src/components/portal-v2/piiModel.test.ts; the REAL transform is pinned in artifacts/api-server/src/lib/portal-pii-governance.test.ts and src/components/portal-v2/piiGovernanceWire.test.ts.

THE TESTBED TENANT HAS NO OK-STATUS BACKING DATA, AND THAT IS STATED PLAINLY. For tenant c4c814d4-3afe-441e-9145-62461d0a4fd3 (tenants.id 1, behind TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL) every one of the four backing checks' most-recent run is status=error ('Could not establish a Security & Compliance session for the target tenant') -- verified live via shaneapp://executeSql. So the honest live state is: findings=[], status 'Not collected', and a coverage panel of four rows each showing the check's real label and a 'Scan error' chip. This manifest asserts that REAL honest state, NOT a fabricated clean result. The tenant_monitor_profiles table is the production scoring surface, so it was deliberately NOT seeded with ok rows (that would corrupt pillar scores platform-wide) -- unlike the risk-register seed, which used an isolated table.

WHY THE COVERAGE LABELS ARE THE REAL API-TO-DOM PROOF. The four 'Where this comes from' labels ('Sensitivity labels defined but disabled', 'Sensitivity label policies failed to distribute', 'DLP policies not actively enforcing', 'DLP-related activity in the last 30 days') are served by the route (from PII_GOVERNANCE_CHECKS in the lib) and rendered from the response, not hardcoded in the page -- so A4's extract of $.coverage[0].label and UI6's textContains of the interpolated {{firstCoverageLabel}} is the genuine endpoint->DOM integration, per CLAUDE.md's apiTests+textContains rule.

THE HEADLINE IS DERIVED, ROBUST ACROSS STATES. piiSignalHeadline always contains the phrase 'governance signal' whether the tenant has live findings ('N data-governance signals need attention'), ok-but-quiet checks ('...are firing on this tenant right now') or no collected data ('...have been collected for this tenant yet'). UI3 asserts that phrase rather than a volatile count, so a later real collection does not turn this red.

THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips login hits the login screen and every assertion fails for an unrelated reason. On a WebView2 with a PERSISTED session the two input steps (#email/#password) can fail because the form never mounts -- with only those two red and every page assertion green, that is a PASS for this feature (see portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session memory).

ROLE FLOOR IS CustomerUser, matching its Governance sibling portal-risk-register.ts (higher than the Assessment floor used by change-control/remediation). TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL is a real CustomerUser (verified against the users/tenants join in portal-risk-register.ts's header), so both the apiTests bearer and the UI login reach the floor.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/pii. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/pii' BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- the /api/portal/pii-governance route is NEW, so the dev server must carry this commit before the route resolves. A run against a build that predates the deploy fails A1 (NotFound/404) or the coverage assertions, which is a not-deployed signal, not a page defect.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD, TEST_PORTAL_SLUG.
